sources.title: mariusweiss/TaxBERT-Tax-Risk-Sentiment · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Intended Use: This model is intended for sentence-level risk sentiment analysis in the context of qualitative corporate tax disclosures. It can be used to classify individual disclosure sentences according to whether they refer to taxes and, if so, whether they indicate tax risk, tax risk mitigation, or a tax-neutral statement.
